subject: SAC-B3 provenance-bearing bounded salience prior

biologicalReference.citation: Zheng et al. (2022), Structured sampling of olfactory input by the fly mushroom body, Current Biology 32(15):3334-3349.e6
biologicalReference.engineeringReading: Observed PN-to-KC connectivity contains non-random overconvergence for primarily food-responsive inputs, but the reported simulations do not establish that this bias universally improves discrimination. SEI therefore evaluates explicit external priors without treating biological bias as authority.

firstSlice.mechanism: Exact Feature{Channel, Key} contribution reweighting before optional normalization and competition.
firstSlice.reason: Use a minimal proxy before changing hash topology or per-feature fanout, so salience effects are not confounded with representation-capacity changes.
ordering: B2 localized or baseline global competition
invariants: current provider default remains no bias
no wildcard or family-wide boost in this slice
substrate does not autonomously create or reinforce rules

syntheticFixtures.interpretation: A 1.01 prior on two externally selected rare relation features changes half of the 16 active dimensions and recovers the structurally aligned candidate in this fixture.
The same small multiplier, when applied to a broader/non-discriminating feature, reverses a correct baseline ordering. Multiplier bounds do not imply ranking stability.

familyNormalization.interpretation: B1 family normalization keeps total family mass bounded while an exact-feature relative prior can still affect winners inside that family.

softLocalizedCompetition.interpretation: Because the first slice applies the prior before B2 competition, the same biased feature slice reaches both family-local and global-residual paths. A local-only versus residual-only scope is not yet evaluated.

localVerification.method: Standalone deterministic Go reconstruction of the current sparse encoder, SUI feature projection, B1 family normalization, B2 local+global competition, and the B3 exact-feature multiplier semantics.

benchmark.subject: reconstruction-only exact-feature bias copy and lookup on the critical fixture input
benchmark.note: This isolates the reconstruction's feature-copy/bias step and is not repository or production performance evidence.
